They wear greaves on their legs, similar to [[Blue Hinox]], but their metal composition makes Black Hinox vulnerable to [[Electricity]]-based attacks. Most of the time, they will be asleep, but they will wake up and begin to attack [[Link]] if he disturbs them. Like all other Hinox, their eyes are vulnerable to attacks. When defeated, they drop [[Hinox Toenail]]s, [[Hinox Tooth|Hinox Teeth]], [[Hinox Guts]], and a range of [[Roasted Food|Roasted]] [[Meat]]s. As part of the [[Shrine Quest]] "[[The Three Giant Brothers]]", Link must retrieve an [[Ancient Orb]] from each of the three Hinox on [[Mount Taran]]. The [[Hinox (Oldest Kin)]] is a Black Hinox, and it is located in the [[Rabella Wetlands]]. After Link defeats [[Calamity Ganon]] for the first time, he will able able to ask [[Kilton]] about Hinox. If Link kills all of the Hinox in [[Hyrule]], including all Black Hinox, Kilton will reward him with the [[Medal of Honor: Hinox]].
